build.beforeDevCommand: cargo build -p termlabd -p termlab-hook && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: cargo build --release -p termlabd -p termlab-hook && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; img-src 'self' data: https://nekos.best https://*.googleusercontent.com https://*.ytimg.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://nekos.best
